title: Medical Insurance Coverage when Foreign Domestic Worker is Put on Special Pass
what_it_is: Medical Insurance Coverage when Foreign Domestic Worker is Put on Special Pass

sections.label: Work Permit cancellation and Special Pass
sections.summary: When an employment contract ends, the employer must cancel the FDW's Work Permit before she departs, and a Special Pass covers the period until departure, with the employer responsible for her upkeep and medical treatment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: When an employment contract ends, the employer is required to cancel the FDW's Work Permit before she departs Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A Special Pass is granted to cover the period between the cancellation of the Work Permit and the FDW's departure from Singapore for her home country.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: During this period, the employer is responsible for the upkeep and maintenance of the FDW, including medical treatment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: So, I want to assure Mr Louis Ng that the mandatory medical insurance purchased by the employer continues to be in force.

sections.label: MOM and Police medical assistance
sections.summary: MOM and the Police will assist the FDW who needs help with medical treatments, including paying for medical bills as required.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM and the Police will assist the FDW who needs help with medical treatments, including paying for medical bills as required.
